verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Paystack API can manage and retrieve transaction data, and that reconciliation is offered through the Dashboard and exports. Nothing documents payout or settlement endpoints, balance-transaction data, or API-level linking of a bank deposit to its underlying charges. Dashboard and export reconciliation is a different, non-agent channel, and generic transaction retrieval does not cover payout-to-charge reconciliation, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
